notes.origin: The Tollholms (task A3, the island group's second map) share Landfall's ground, kit and sea: this file is sw_isle.json's palette, measured there in the client survey (game-look fix stage), so the two maps meet without a seam in colour. Only the props section is the Tollholms' own.
notes.grade: None: a continent region (its manifest has continentGeography), so a grade section would be ignored (look_profile.gd map_trim). Sky and fog come from the manifest, Crownwater's lagoon as on sw_isle; sky.haze_warmth 0.1 as there.
notes.ground: As sw_isle: the green meadow patches (the meadow, orchard and wheat-stubble regions) at meadow_value 0.76 and tint [0.72, 1, 0.6]; the roads at path_luma 0.2; the opaque Meshy base as a BIOME verge with all of the detail tile's grain (verge_grain 1), calmer on the cone's cliffs (verge_grain_steep 0.3); the coastal gravel patches as solid rock at rock_value 0.32; the square's, the Ringholm court's and the moles' limestone paving at paving_tint [0.6, 0.53, 0.42].
notes.grass: As sw_isle: grass follows the base's green (open_green 1), so the beaches, the cut faces and the talus grow none.
notes.foliage: As sw_isle: the same kit trees and shrubs (the census of a3/dress.py is sw_isle's species mix).
notes.props: keep_words: the Toll Tower (N11, the isle's harbour tower: cobalt roof, gold frames) and the Ringholm watch tower (O1: a slate cone over a gold eave band) keep their signature chroma. hole_words: the two towers and the windmill, the Tollholms' tall landmarks, keep a hole round the player instead of vanishing when they stand between the camera and the player (as sw_isle's towers do).
notes.water: The same continent-sea decode as sw_isle (sea_value 8.5, sea_chroma 1.25, sea_tint [0.55, 1, 1.05]): the two maps' seas meet at x 2437, and any other value would draw a step in the sea's colour along the seam.
